module.CEditableModule.name: CXL - Algorithmic Reverberation
module.notes:
CXL
v0.0.1m

going for a dark moody early lexicon 224 meets hardworn emt 140 vibe with this one. I was thinking maybe emulate a 12bit AD/DA response for normal verb lengths but then drop to 8bit for longer ambiences 

I also want particular attention payed to the mono capabilities. I am designing this in stereo for options as a send effect, but 99% of the time this will be used in mono. Jacking into the left input and not the right input drives the verb in mono in, if there is only a jack in the left output its mono out. Jack in the right input only is like its in the left only. Both jacks together gets processed in stereo. One jack in the right output taps the right side of the stereo signal, left alone is a mono sum, both output jacks equals stereo.

controls.CEditableControl.name: switchADDA
controls.notes:
Up=12bit conversion and a 140 style length of decay
Down=8bit conversion and somewhat noiser long ambient decay. The consequence of length is reduced bitdepth and maybe sampling rate
